sources.title: wa_gsd_basemap
sources.dsn:
<GDAL_WMS>
  <!-- WA GSD external basemap, GDA2020 (EPSG:7844), ArcGIS tile cache: origin (-400, 400), 256 px tiles,
       level-0 resolution 0.08798912593428897 deg halving to level 15, 24 x 20 tiles at level 0.
       From .../GSD_Basemap_External/MapServer?f=json (tileInfo). -->
  <Service name="TMS">
    <ServerUrl>https://gissdi.dmp.wa.gov.au/gisexternal/rest/services/External/GSD_Basemap_External/MapServer/tile/${z}/${y}/${x}</ServerUrl>
  </Service>
  <DataWindow>
    <UpperLeftX>-400</UpperLeftX>
    <UpperLeftY>399.9999999999998</UpperLeftY>
    <LowerRightX>140.605189740271</LowerRightX>
    <LowerRightY>-50.504324783560</LowerRightY>
    <TileLevel>15</TileLevel>
    <TileCountX>24</TileCountX>
    <TileCountY>20</TileCountY>
    <YOrigin>top</YOrigin>
  </DataWindow>
  <Projection>EPSG:7844</Projection>
  <BlockSizeX>256</BlockSizeX>
  <BlockSizeY>256</BlockSizeY>
  <BandsCount>4</BandsCount>
  <ZeroBlockHttpCodes>204,404</ZeroBlockHttpCodes>
  <MaxConnections>4</MaxConnections>
  <Cache/>
</GDAL_WMS>
sources.notes: WA GSD external basemap (GDA2020), via GDAL_WMS TMS on the ArcGIS tile cache. Its WMTS capabilities put the tile matrix origin (-400, 400) in lon/lat order for EPSG:7844, so GDAL's WMTS driver finds no zoom level; the TMS description sets the grid directly (16 levels, 256 px, level-0 resolution 0.08798912593428897 deg).
